ground_truth: _job_metadata was added to HoglahExtractor, but the call sites that actually submit live on the submitter classes (_StoreSubmitter and _MessagingSubmitter), neither of which had the method. Every specialist call therefore raised AttributeError, which the provider boundary converted into terminal_reason='blocked' with no model calls at all. The unit test passed because it exercised the extractor's helper rather than the submitters' call path - it tested the object that has the method instead of the ones that call it. The fix is to put _job_metadata on the shared _Submitter base so both transports have it.
